keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «라이트 형제가 최초로 동력 비행기 비행에 성공했다(주제)» 와 «그 성공이 사람이 정말 날 수 있음을 보여 주었다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (the Wright brothers made the first successful powered airplane flight) and the conclusion (their success showed that people could really fly). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why did the brothers build a small wind tunnel?
qs.qko: 형제는 왜 작은 풍동(바람 터널)을 만들었나요?
opts: To test the shapes of wings
To sell more bicycles in Ohio
To carry their airplane to Kitty Hawk
evs: They also built a small wind tunnel to test the shapes of wings.
The brothers owned a bicycle shop in Ohio, and they loved to build machines.
Their first flight took place near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina.
Orville flew the plane for only about 12 seconds and traveled about 37 meters.
why: 날개 모양을 시험하려고 작은 풍동을 만들었다고 글에 그대로 나와요.
The text says they built a small wind tunnel to test the shapes of wings.

qs.q: In "the first successful powered airplane flight," what does "powered" mean?
qs.qko: «the first successful powered airplane flight» 에서 «powered» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: Finally, they built an airplane with an engine and called it the Flyer.
They studied how birds fly and tested many gliders for several years.
That day, they made four flights, and the longest one lasted almost one minute.
On December 17, 1903, two brothers changed the history of travel.
why: 형제는 «엔진이 달린» 비행기를 만들어 날았어요. 그래서 powered 는 엔진의 힘으로 움직인다는 뜻이에요.
The brothers built an airplane «with an engine», so «powered» means moved by an engine.

qs.q: Which clues show that the brothers prepared for a long time before they flew?
qs.qko: 형제가 날기 전에 오랫동안 준비했다는 단서는 무엇인가요?
opts: They studied birds, tested gliders for years, and tested wing shapes
They flew for one hour on their very first try
They bought an airplane from another country
evs: They studied how birds fly and tested many gliders for several years.
Orville flew the plane for only about 12 seconds and traveled about 37 meters.
They also built a small wind tunnel to test the shapes of wings.
Their first flight took place near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina.
why: 몇 년 동안 새를 연구하고 글라이더를 시험했으며, 날개 모양을 시험하려고 풍동까지 만들었다고 했어요. 두 문장을 이어야 해요.
They studied birds and tested gliders for several years, and they also built a wind tunnel to test wings. You need both sentences.

ends: Who was the first person to fly across the Atlantic Ocean?
